_provenance.scope: Statutory programme-of-study statements only (the 'Pupils should be taught' lists), verbatim. Non-statutory notes and guidance, aims, purpose of study and appendices are not included.

statements.subject: music
statements.text: use their voices expressively and creatively by singing songs and speaking chants and rhymes

statements.subject: music
statements.text: play tuned and untuned instruments musically

statements.subject: music
statements.text: listen with concentration and understanding to a range of high-quality live and recorded music

statements.subject: music
statements.text: experiment with, create, select and combine sounds using the interrelated dimensions of music

statements.subject: music
statements.text: play and perform in solo and ensemble contexts, using their voices and playing musical instruments with increasing accuracy, fluency, control and expression

statements.subject: music
statements.text: improvise and compose music for a range of purposes using the interrelated dimensions of music

statements.subject: music
statements.text: listen with attention to detail and recall sounds with increasing aural memory

statements.subject: music
statements.text: use and understand staff and other musical notations

statements.subject: music
statements.text: appreciate and understand a wide range of high-quality live and recorded music drawn from different traditions and from great composers and musicians

statements.subject: music
statements.text: develop an understanding of the history of music

statements.subject: music
statements.text: play and perform confidently in a range of solo and ensemble contexts using their voice, playing instruments musically, fluently and with accuracy and expression

statements.subject: music
statements.text: improvise and compose; and extend and develop musical ideas by drawing on a range of musical structures, styles, genres and traditions

statements.subject: music
statements.text: use staff and other relevant notations appropriately and accurately in a range of musical styles, genres and traditions

statements.subject: music
statements.text: identify and use the interrelated dimensions of music expressively and with increasing sophistication, including use of tonalities, different types of scales and other musical devices

statements.subject: music
statements.text: listen with increasing discrimination to a wide range of music from great composers and musicians

statements.subject: music
statements.text: develop a deepening understanding of the music that they perform and to which they listen, and its history
